Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff
Series XXIII: Pride and Progress / The Right Stuff

Pride and Progress News-highlights: 1. Jerry Falwell loses $5000 for on-air anti-gay comments 2. Chicago, mayor's endorsement of gay civil rights bill despite its defeat, and stamping of US currency with "gay dollar" COMMERCIAL: Gay Cable Network fundraiser 3. Interview with Michael Hardwick and Sue Lebo, a member of the Lesbian Rights Project, regarding the next step in combating decision in Georgia sodomy case, Bowers v Hardwick COMMERCIAL: "First Hand" gay magazine 4. Alexandria, Virginia gay community sponsors advertizing campaign to promote acceptance of homosexuals 5. Andy Humm on the death of Diego Lopez, director of the Gay Men's Health Crisis, and the need for more activism and involvement in the community COMMERCIAL: "New York Native" with Quentin Crisp 6. San Francisco mayor Diane Feinstein states city's gay pride parade promotes rampant and un-safe promiscuity 7. Dallas Gay Alliance places billboards in low-income and ethnic areas to help educate minorities about AIDS 8. Authorities urging all those who are high risk for infection to take the HTLVIII antibody test 9. Washington State Insurance Commission holds last public hearing on insurance companies using HTLVIII antibody testing and lifestyle questions to deny coverage COMMERCIAL: SF AIDS Foundation with Jose Sarria 10. Sports Report 11. Closing credits
The Right Stuff: 1. Media Watch with Brandon Judell, clips from "Betty Blue" 2. Clips for ABC's coverage of Lyndon LaRouche and California AIDS quarantine bill 3. Attempt to turn Rhyolite, Nevada into the first town for gays 4. Another clip from "Betty Blue" COMMERCIAL: "Manscape" gay magazine COMMERCIAL: GCN's "SUDS" gay soap opera looking for locations 5. Conclusion of interview with director Derek Jarman COMMERCIAL: Gay Cable Network fundraiser 6. Closing credits
